Two wires, X and Y, both carry currents into the plane of the page. The current in wire X is and the current in wire Y is .

Consider the following statements:

I. The force exerted by X on Y is greater than the force exerted by Y on X.

II. The force experienced by X is inversely proportional to the distance between the wires. 

III. The force between X and Y is attractive.

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
